request.style: English, male baritone voice, solo with choir, piano, strings, harp, organ, solemn and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Jeconiah the captive
Shealtiel was his first born son
Malchiram and Pedaiah too
Shenazzar stood beside him

[Verse]
Jekamiah and Hoshama named
With Nedabiah in the list
A lineage kept in Babylon
While Jerusalem lay in dust

[Verse]
He took the king to Babylon
With mothers wives and court attendants
The strong and fit for war
Led into exile far away

[Verse]
In thirty-seven years of exile
Evil-merodach set him free
He spoke kindly to the king
And gave him a seat of honor

[Verse]
Prison clothes were put aside
To eat at the king's table
A regular allowance given
Day by day as he lived on
